name: 道の駅 吉野ヶ里
desc: 国道385号沿い、脊振山系に位置する「道の駅 吉野ヶ里（さざんか千坊館）」。施設の展望所からは佐賀平野を一望できる抜群の景色が広がります。物産館には朝採れの新鮮な野菜や果物が並び、脊振の天然水を使った焼きたてパンや旬のフルーツスイーツが大人気。さらに、敷地内には美味しい湧き水を無料で汲める給水所もあり、絶景と豊かな自然の恵みを心ゆくまで満喫できるドライブの立ち寄りスポットです。
descEn: Located along National Route 385 in the Sefuri mountains, "Michi-no-Eki Yoshinogari (Sasanka Senbokan)" offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Saga plain from its observation deck. The local market is filled with freshly harvested vegetables and fruits, alongside crowd favorites like freshly baked bread made with natural spring water from the Sefuri mountains and seasonal fruit sweets. Complete with a public water station where visitors can freely collect delicious local spring water, it is a wonderful destination to enjoy magnificent scenery and natural bounties during a drive.
